entries.hypothesis: Round 37's own claims (C1 composed clue readings, C2 U4/U7/U8, C3 re-scores, T1 plumbing) and the Round 36 X1 carry-overs survive a refute-by-default audit.
entries.result: FOUND-ERROR: (1) U4 line boundaries misaligned on pages with interrupters (03: 4/8 -> 3/8, pooled 22 -> 21/60, pages p<0.05 2 -> 1; verdict NO-SEPARATION unchanged); (2) C1 candidates.json omits 2 of the 7 signed-2016 clauses ('Seek and you will be found', 'Beware false paths. Verify OpenPGP 7A35090F'), and U2's 'line' sequences use koans-file lines that match the printed lines (data/scream314_lp.md) only on A WARNING, contrary to C1's 'not otherwise recorded'; (3) C1 U3 'literal' label is C1's operationalization (skipped: lagged cipher-word gematria pointer, O4 U3 seed orders, & $ boundaries; semantic 'meaning' untested); (4) C3 swapped the null (and added a two-statistic rule) after seeing first-pass real-data p(Z) < 0.01 on N1-PT, N2, N4-read -> threshold_fixed_in_advance=false on 4 rows; (5) C3 patch wording 'replaced ... remains negative' wrong for measured rows (applied corrected); (6) O4 matrix.md / untried.md / counts.json still say NEVER 68 although RESULTS says 66 (H7xF2, H12xF2 not edited). (7) I1 RESULTS.md headline predates the coordinator-ordered control completion (says no register passed at L=400/729; addendum, ledger and stream say 12/12 at L=400 (OE 19/20) and 12/12 at L=729), and bar_v3(..,120,'free') still returns the R34 9-register node while L>=240 are 12-register nodes. NO-ERROR-FOUND: I1 fit/bars/controls recomputed from raw streams, I2 FPR/power/store/bars recomputed (every register >= 0.952, 0 flagged), C1 re-runs (U1 x2, U3 x3 fresh-seed plants), C1 addendum append (17,392 rows, header unchanged), U4 decision rule fixed before data, U7 index-alphabet null and control-B explanation, U8 inconclusive label, C3 degenerate filter (constant outputs only), C3 z=6.94 re-score (pmax 3.94, single-reading p ~0.07), N5 bars (6.897), T1 backward compatibility, I1-R36 doc corrections, B2/S1 patch supersession, capsule PASS. See analysis/round37/X1-redteam/RESULTS.md.
